intro.heading: A Hospital Built on Humanity and Hope
intro.body: Trust-based, non-profit healthcare institution dedicated to serving humanity. More than 90% of patients receive treatment completely free of cost, ensuring access for the underprivileged and deserving. Guided by compassion, transparency, and service, Hijaz Hospital believes that healthcare is a right, not a privilege — providing three-time free, quality meals to both patients and their attendants, and ensuring dignity, comfort, and holistic care beyond medical treatment.
intro.quote: To care for the ailing with compassion, respect, dignity, and professional excellence, while ensuring that financial hardship never stands in the way of receiving care

engage.heading: How You Can Engage with Hijaz Hospital
engage.lede: "Whoever saves one life, it is as if he has saved all mankind."(Qur'an 5:32) Every act of giving helps save lives. Whether you choose to give Zakat, Sadaqah, General Donation, Eidi, or Fitrana, your generosity enables Hijaz Hospital Trust to provide quality healthcare to deserving patients who cannot afford treatment.

waysToGive.heading: How to Donate
waysToGive.lede: Supporting Hijaz Hospital Trust is simple, secure, and impactful. Choose the donation method that is most convenient for you — online, JazzCash Till, bank transfer, or other ways to give.

online.heading: Donate securely via JazzCash
online.body: Donate securely through our online payment gateway using your debit or credit card. All online donations are processed through a secure platform, and a confirmation receipt will be provided.

jazzcash.heading: JazzCash Till
jazzcash.body: Donate quickly and conveniently through mobile payment services.
jazzcash.qrNote: QR Code · add JazzCash QR in Admin (donationMethods)

otherWays.title: Cheque or Bank Draft
otherWays.body: Donations may also be made through cheque or bank draft payable to Hijaz Social Welfare Society (Hijaz Hospital).

otherWays.title: In-Person Donations
otherWays.body: You can make your donation directly at our hospital front desk or donation counters. Our staff will provide you with an official receipt.

otherWays.title: Zakat & Sadaqah Contributions
otherWays.body: We accept Zakat year-round and ensure it is distributed strictly according to Islamic principles to those eligible.

otherWays.title: Pick-Up Donation Service
otherWays.body: For your convenience, our authorized representatives can collect donations from your home or office.

otherWays.title: Meezan Mobile App
otherWays.body: Hijaz Hospital is available as a trusted donation recipient on the Meezan Mobile App, offering donors a secure, convenient, and Shariah-compliant way to support our healthcare services.

otherWays.title: QR Code Donation
otherWays.body: Scan the QR code using your banking or mobile wallet application to make a secure donation in just a few simple steps.

founders.heading: Our Founders
founders.lede: A legacy of compassion, integrity, and service that shaped Hijaz Hospital.

cards.name: Inam Elahi Asar
cards.body: Born in October 1927 in Chiniot, he devoted more than five decades to humanitarian service. His enduring legacy is Hijaz Hospital — a charitable institution founded on compassion, dignity, and service to those who cannot afford care.

cards.name: Mian Abdul Waheed (1931–2010)
cards.body: A founding member and principal driving force alongside Inam Elahi Asar, he shaped Hijaz Hospital from a dispensary into a 200-bedded charitable healthcare institution through visionary leadership and unwavering commitment to public welfare.

news.heading: Latest News
news.lede: Stay updated with the latest developments, announcements, and health insights from Hijaz Hospital.

items.title: Dengue Awareness Campaign 2026
items.body: Hijaz Hospital organized a dengue awareness campaign featuring an awareness walk led by MS Dr. Arfan Ishaque and hospital staff, followed by an educational session on dengue symptoms, prevention, and precautionary measures.

items.title: Annual Farewell Dinner 2026
items.body: Hosted by Haji Inam Elahi School of Paramedics, the Annual Farewell Dinner celebrated graduating students and their academic achievements, reflecting the institution's commitment to developing skilled healthcare professionals.

items.title: International Nurses Day 2026
items.body: Hijaz Hospital celebrated International Nurses Day to honor the dedication, compassion, and tireless efforts of its nursing staff. The event recognized their vital role in delivering quality healthcare and supporting patients around the clock.

items.title: Visit of Dr. Muhammad Iqbal Hussain
items.body: Hijaz Hospital had the honor of welcoming Dr. Muhammad Iqbal Hussain, who was received by the Chairman and senior executive members. A distinguished medical specialist practicing in the United States, Dr. Hussain is recognized for his lifelong humanitarian services through the International Trust Bait-ul-Maal and his continued association with PKLI, where he provides voluntary medical services annually.

items.title: Farewell Ceremony for Dr. Nadeem Iqbal
items.body: Hijaz Hospital honored Dr. Nadeem Iqbal upon the completion of his remarkable 15 years of dedicated service. The farewell ceremony recognized his professional excellence, unwavering commitment to patient care, and invaluable contributions to the hospital. The management and staff extended their heartfelt appreciation and best wishes for his future endeavors.

machinery.heading: Latest Machinery & Advanced Medical Technology
machinery.lede: Equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic and treatment equipment, Hijaz Hospital ensures accurate diagnosis, safer procedures, and improved patient outcomes. From advanced dialysis machines and modern ICU monitoring systems to digital X-ray, ultrasound, and lithotripsy technology, our facilities are continuously upgraded to meet the highest standards of quality healthcare.
